data.name: Next Station is...
data.detailed_description:
Welcome aboard the final subway train of the night.

You are the driver, and every station brings the same responsibility: inspect the platform, observe the passengers, and decide whether it is safe to open the doors.

Most stops seem ordinary.

Some are not.

Study the station from the driver's cabin and security cameras. Look for unusual passengers, suspicious behavior, environmental anomalies, and anything that feels out of place.

Your task is simple:

If the station is safe, open the doors.

If something is wrong, bypass the station.

But every decision has consequences. Opening the doors to the wrong passengers may put everyone on board at risk, while repeatedly leaving legitimate passengers behind will attract the attention of your employer.

Follow procedure. Stay on schedule. Trust your judgment.

The train must keep moving.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains psychological horror, frightening imagery, disturbing situations, sudden scares, and occasional depictions of blood and corpses. Violence and death may be implied through environmental storytelling.
